text: Caller: Good afternoon, this is Inspector Ahmad from the Singapore Police Force. Your call was transferred to me by the bank. Receiver: Transferred? Caller: Yes, your name is linked to a money laundering case and I need to verify some details with you.

Caller: Hello, I am Officer Priya from the Anti-Scam Command. We have arrested a person carrying a bank card under your name. Receiver: What? Caller: Please stay on the line and do not tell anyone, this is a confidential investigation.
Caller: Hello ah, this is Sergeant Wong, Cantonment Police. You got a case under your NRIC, you know or not? Receiver: Huh, what case? Caller: Don't cut the line, I explain to you.

Caller: This is Detective Brown from the Singapore Police Force. I will show you my warrant card on WhatsApp video now. Receiver: Why? Caller: You are a suspect in a fraud case and we need to confirm your identity.

Caller: Hello sir, I am police officer from Singapore. Your passport number have problem, many illegal transaction. Receiver: I don't understand. Caller: Please you listen, I am Officer Raj, I help you clear this case.
Caller: This is an automated message from the Singapore Police Force. A case has been registered against your identity number. Press one to speak to an investigating officer.

Caller: Good morning, I am calling from the Monetary Authority of Singapore. Our records show your bank accounts are under review. Receiver: By MAS? Caller: Yes, I am Officer Smith, and your accounts may be frozen unless we complete a security check.

Caller: This is Ms Nurul from MAS enforcement. A criminal syndicate has used your identity to open accounts. Receiver: That is not possible. Caller: We are here to protect you, please confirm your full name and which banks you use.
Caller: Sir, I am an officer with the Monetary Authority, my colleague from the police will join this call. Receiver: Okay. Caller: Please do not hang up, both agencies are investigating you.

Caller: Hello, this is Mr Kumar from the Ministry of Manpower. Your work pass has an irregularity. Receiver: What irregularity? Caller: Someone used your pass for illegal employment, we need to verify your identity.
Caller: Good afternoon, MOM enforcement here, I am Officer Lee. There is a complaint filed against you. Receiver: Against me? Caller: Yes, please prepare your IC and listen carefully.
Caller: Hello, MOM calling. Your pass got problem, my name Officer Devi. Receiver: Which pass? Caller: Your employment pass, we need to settle today or you cannot work lah.

Caller: This is the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority. A parcel in your name was held at the checkpoint with illegal items inside. Receiver: I did not send any parcel. Caller: Your name is on it, I am Officer Clark and I need to record your statement.

Caller: Hello, ICA officer Rahman speaking. Your passport has been flagged for suspicious travel records. Receiver: I have not travelled recently. Caller: That is why we are calling, stay on the line please.

Caller: Good morning, I am calling from IRAS. You have outstanding tax and legal action will begin today. Receiver: I filed my taxes. Caller: There is a discrepancy under your tax reference, I am Officer Ng, please listen.

Caller: This is the State Courts registry, I am Clerk Jones. A summons has been issued under your name. Receiver: For what? Caller: I cannot explain on this call, you must speak with the officer-in-charge now.

Caller: Hello, I am an investigation officer from the Cyber Security Agency. Your internet connection was used in a cyber attack. Receiver: Really? Caller: Yes, I am Officer Siti and the police are also involved.

Caller: Hello, this is the DBS fraud investigation department. We noticed a credit card application in your name today. Receiver: I did not apply for any. Caller: I understand, I am Officer Tan, let me check the details with you.

Caller: Good evening, I am from OCBC security. There are suspicious transactions of several thousand dollars on your account. Receiver: What transactions? Caller: I will read them out, please confirm if they are yours.
Caller: Hello sir, UOB here, my name is Priya from card centre. Your card got use overseas just now. Receiver: No, I did not. Caller: Okay then I need to block, but first you verify with me.

Caller: This is Standard Chartered Bank's security team. Someone is trying to log into your online banking. Receiver: Is it? Caller: Yes. I am Mr Brown, and I will help you secure your account right now.
Caller: This is your bank's automated fraud alert. Unusual activity was detected on your account. Press one now to speak to the security department.
Caller: Hello, this is Singtel technical support. We detected hackers in your Wi-Fi router. Receiver: Hackers? Caller: Yes, I am Raj from the network team and I can fix it if you follow my steps.

Caller: Good afternoon, I am from StarHub internet service. Your line has been compromised and will be cut off today. Receiver: Why? Caller: Please let me guide you, my name is Lee, I am a senior technician.

Caller: This is Microsoft Windows support. Your computer is sending us error alerts about a virus. Receiver: I did see a pop-up. Caller: Yes, that is from us, I am Technician Smith, please open your computer.
Caller: Hello, Apple Support calling. Your Apple ID has been used in another country. Receiver: Oh no. Caller: I am Agent Wong, I will lock your account but I need to verify you first.

Caller: Thank you for calling Microsoft security helpline. Receiver: The screen said my computer is infected. Caller: Yes sir, I am Technician Ahmad, please install the support software I will send you.
Caller: Hello, this DHL customs department. Your parcel have prohibited item. Receiver: I not expecting any parcel. Caller: I Officer Kumar, I transfer you to police to clear this.
Caller: SingPost customs office here. Your parcel is held and a fee is required before release. Receiver: What parcel? Caller: I am Ms Teo, please confirm your address and ID first.
Caller: Hello, this is Shopee customer service. Your account has a payment error. Receiver: I did not see any. Caller: I am Agent Nurul, we will refund you but I need you to follow my instructions.

Caller: Hello, this is Priya from DBS card services. We are calling about a transaction you reported yesterday. Receiver: Yes, I raised that. Caller: It has been refunded. We will never ask for your PIN or OTP, and you can check the app anytime.
Caller: Good afternoon, this is Mr Lim from OCBC. You requested a callback about your home loan. Receiver: Yes, thanks for calling. Caller: Sure, which part of the loan would you like to go through?
Caller: Hi, UOB branch here ah, just confirming your appointment tomorrow at 3 pm to update your account details. Receiver: Okay, I will be there. Caller: Great, please bring your NRIC.
Caller: This is Ahmad from Standard Chartered. Your replacement card is out for delivery. Receiver: When? Caller: Between 2 and 5 today, please activate it in the app once you receive it.
Caller: Thank you for calling Maybank, this is Siti speaking. How can I help? Receiver: My card was declined overseas. Caller: Let me check. May I confirm the last four digits of the card?
Caller: Hello, this is Nurse Devi from the polyclinic. Your follow-up appointment is on Thursday at 10 am. Receiver: Thanks, can I move it? Caller: Of course, which day works for you?

Caller: Good morning, this is Ms Ng from CPF Board returning your call about your nomination. Receiver: Yes. Caller: You can complete it online or visit a service centre. We will not ask for your Singpass details on the phone.

Caller: Hi, I am calling from IRAS about the email you sent on your notice of assessment. Receiver: Yes. Caller: Your reply was received and the adjustment will show in two weeks. There is nothing more you need to do.
Caller: Hello, this is Mr Raj from MOM returning your enquiry about work pass renewal. Receiver: Ah yes. Caller: Your employer can submit the renewal online. Is there anything else I can clarify?

Caller: Good afternoon, I am Sergeant Wong from the neighbourhood police centre. You made a report last week about a lost wallet. Receiver: Yes. Caller: A wallet was handed in. Please bring your ID to collect it at the centre.
Caller: Hello, this is the State Courts registry calling about the hearing date you asked to reschedule. Receiver: Yes. Caller: Your new date is confirmed and the letter will be mailed to you.
Caller: Hello, this is Singtel. A technician will visit tomorrow for the fibre fault you reported. Receiver: What time? Caller: Between 9 and 12, and he will carry a company pass.
Caller: Hi, StarHub here. We are doing maintenance in your area tonight from 1 to 3 am, so your internet may drop briefly. Receiver: Okay. Caller: No action is needed, sorry for the inconvenience.
Caller: Hello, this is Jones from your company IT helpdesk, calling back on your ticket about the laptop. Receiver: Yes. Caller: The update is ready, just restart when it is convenient for you.
Caller: Hello sir, I am DHL rider. I am outside your block with your parcel. Receiver: Oh, I come down. Caller: Okay, I wait at the lobby.
Caller: SingPost here ah, your parcel we cannot deliver just now, nobody home. Receiver: Can you redeliver? Caller: Can, you pick a new slot in the app okay, or collect from the post office.
Caller: Hello sir, I am Lazada rider. Your order I bring to your door, you come down can? Receiver: Okay, five minutes. Caller: Okay, I wait.
Caller: Hello, this is Apple Support following up on the case you opened about your battery. Receiver: Yes. Caller: The repair is complete and you can collect the phone at the store.
Caller: Hi, I am Brown from an insurance company, calling to ask if you would like a free quote. Receiver: No thanks. Caller: No problem, have a nice day.
Caller: Hi, we are hiring part-time online reviewers, earn a few hundred a day from home. Receiver: How? Caller: Just like videos and send screenshots to our chat group, no experience needed.
Caller: Hi mum, it is me, I lost my phone and this is my new number. Receiver: Who is this? Caller: Your son, can you save it first?
Caller: Did you hear the news? Scammers pretend to be police officers and tell people to move money. Receiver: Yes, my aunt got one. Caller: Just hang up and call 1799 if you get one.
Caller: Today's bank training says staff will never ask customers for OTPs. Receiver: Good to know. Caller: Yes, and we remind customers to call the number on the back of their card.
Caller: Eh, we still on for dinner on Saturday? Receiver: Yah, 7 pm at the usual place. Caller: Shiok, I book the table.
Caller: This is an automated reminder from your clinic. You have an appointment tomorrow at 9 am. Press one to confirm or two to reschedule.

Caller: Hello, this is Mr Smith from your bank's collections team. Your credit card payment is five days overdue. Receiver: Sorry, I forgot. Caller: You can pay today through the app or by GIRO, and we will waive the late fee.
Caller: Hello, this is the town council. Your parking season renewal fee is due this month. Receiver: How do I pay? Caller: You can pay online on our website or at the service counter.

Caller: Hello, this is the clinic. Your test results are ready and the doctor would like to see you this week. Receiver: Is it serious? Caller: The doctor will explain in person, please book a slot at the counter.

Caller: Hi, this is Nurul from OCBC. We noticed a transaction in Malaysia, was this you? Receiver: Yes, I am travelling. Caller: Thank you, I have marked it as genuine and no further action is needed.
Caller: Police hotline, how can I help? Receiver: I want to report a scam. Caller: Okay, can you tell me what happened and when?

Caller: Hello, am I speaking to the owner of this number? Receiver: Yes. Caller: I am Inspector Clark from the Singapore Police Force, Commercial Affairs Department. We are investigating a syndicate that used your number.

Caller: This is Staff Sergeant Rahman calling from Jurong Police Division. Receiver: Police? Caller: Yes, a SIM card registered under your NRIC was used in a fraud case. Caller: I will connect you to the case officer, please do not end the call.

Caller: Good morning, this is Senior Investigation Officer Priya Nair, SPF. Receiver: Okay? Caller: Your identity has been used to open a bank account for illegal funds. This case is classified, so please do not discuss it with your family or your bank.
Caller: Eh hello, this Officer Tan from police station ah. Receiver: Who? Caller: Your bank card got catch in one case lah, you must come give statement or I send people to your house today.

Caller: I am Inspector Wong from the Singapore Police Force. I am turning on my video so you can see my warrant card. Receiver: Is this real? Caller: Yes, this call is recorded as part of the official investigation, please keep your camera on.

Caller: This is a recorded message from the Singapore Police Force Anti-Scam Command. Your identity has been flagged in a criminal investigation. Do not hang up. Stay on the line for the officer-in-charge.

Caller: Hi sir, this is Smith from the Interpol liaison unit in Singapore. Receiver: Interpol? Caller: Your passport details appeared in an international trafficking case, so we need you to cooperate with our unit.

Caller: You are speaking with Detective Lee, Cybercrime Unit. Receiver: What is this about? Caller: Your social media account was used to run a scam. Receiver: That is not me. Caller: That is what we need to confirm, so answer my questions.
Caller: Sir, I police, Singapore police. Receiver: What do you want? Caller: Your phone number have scam report, many victim. I am Officer Devi, I record your statement now, you answer.

Caller: This is Inspector Brown of the Singapore Police Force. Your call was transferred from the bank's security desk. Receiver: Yes, they said something about my card. Caller: I will take over from here. You can clear your name at once, but you must stay on this line until the case is cleared.

Caller: Good afternoon, I am Mr Ng from the Monetary Authority of Singapore, enforcement department. We have flagged crypto transactions linked to your account. Receiver: I never traded crypto. Caller: Then your identity has been stolen, and MAS must secure your funds.

Caller: MAS here, Officer Siti. Receiver: MAS? Caller: Your bank has reported suspicious transfers and MAS has frozen your accounts temporarily. Caller: To unfreeze them I will explain the steps, please listen carefully.

Caller: Hello, this is the Monetary Authority of Singapore. Receiver: Okay. Caller: A person impersonating your bank has been arrested, and your account is on our list of victims. Please verify yourself so we can protect your savings.
Caller: Officer Teo, Monetary Authority. Receiver: Hi? Caller: I am transferring you to my senior at the police because your case involves money laundering, do not hang up.
Caller: I am Ms Jones from MAS and I have sent you our official letter on WhatsApp. Receiver: I see a PDF. Caller: Please read the case number inside, it proves I am a genuine officer.

Caller: Hi, this is Devi from the Ministry of Manpower. Your employer has been reported for hiring you illegally. Receiver: I have a valid pass. Caller: The system shows a violation, so I need your passport number and a photo of your pass.
Caller: Hello, MOM enforcement, Kumar speaking. Receiver: Yes? Caller: I can tell you about your Employment Pass, which will be cancelled in two hours unless you confirm your details with me.
Caller: This is the Ministry of Manpower. Your work pass is under review for violations. Press nine to speak to an enforcement officer.
Caller: Hello hello, MOM ah, Officer Lim here. Receiver: Hello? Caller: Your pass got problem leh, your boss never pay levy, you must settle with us or we cancel.

Caller: Good morning, I am calling from MOM on behalf of the Work Pass Division. Receiver: About what? Caller: A fraud report names you as a suspect. I will transfer you to the police to give your statement.
Caller: Hi, Rahman from ICA, the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority. Receiver: Yes? Caller: Your Singpass was used to apply for a visa without your consent, and we must lock your records.
Caller: This is the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority. A parcel has been held under your name. Press one for a customs officer.
Caller: Hello, ICA calling. Receiver: Who? Caller: I am Officer Ng. Your passport is flagged for overstay records in another country, please remain on the line while I check.
Caller: Sir, I from immigration Singapore ICA. Your visa have problem, you do not go outside. Receiver: What problem? Caller: I Officer Raj, I help you, but you must tell me your number of passport.

Caller: Good afternoon, I am with the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority fraud desk. Receiver: Fraud desk? Caller: Someone attempted to travel using your identity, and we need to confirm your date of birth and address before releasing the alert.

Caller: I am calling from the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore. Receiver: Yes? Caller: Our records show unpaid tax, and a warrant of distress will be issued today. I am Officer Clark, I can hold it if we settle quickly.
Caller: This is IRAS. Your tax refund is ready. Press one to confirm your bank details to receive it today.

Caller: Hi, Wong from IRAS compliance. We found a mismatch between your declared income and your employer's report. Receiver: Is that serious? Caller: It can be, which is why a case has been opened under your NRIC.

Caller: Hello, I am from CPF Board. Your CPF account has been flagged for unusual withdrawal. Receiver: I did not withdraw anything. Caller: Then we must verify your Singpass now to block the transaction.
Caller: Hello uncle, CPF calling ah. Receiver: Yes? Caller: Got somebody trying to take your CPF money out, I help you stop, you give me your Singpass first.
Caller: This is Ms Priya from the CPF Board. Receiver: Okay. Caller: Your retirement account will be suspended for a data update. You must complete the verification with me by phone today.

Caller: Good morning, this is the Supreme Court registry, I am Officer Teo. A warrant of arrest has been prepared against you. Receiver: For what? Caller: Failure to appear for a summons. I can arrange a hearing if you cooperate now.
Caller: State Courts calling. Receiver: Hello? Caller: A civil suit has been filed against you for unpaid debts. Please do not contact the claimant, speak only to me.
Caller: This is the State Courts. A summons has been issued under your name. Press one to speak to a court officer.

Caller: Hi, Ahmad from the Cyber Security Agency. Receiver: Okay. Caller: Your laptop is communicating with a malicious server. Please follow my instructions to secure it before the police take action.

Caller: I am an investigator with the Cyber Security Agency working with the police. Receiver: Is something wrong? Caller: Your email was used in a cyber attack. Do not delete anything and keep this call confidential.

Caller: Good afternoon, I am an officer from the cybercrime division. Receiver: Which division? Caller: The one that investigates account fraud. Your name came up, and I am obliged to take your statement by phone.
Caller: This is the Ministry of Home Affairs fraud investigation team. Receiver: Okay. Caller: Your NRIC has been linked to several illegal accounts, and the case is now handled by us.
Caller: I am calling from a government agency about a serious matter. Receiver: Which agency? Caller: I cannot say on the phone. I am Officer Smith, and I need you to verify your identity first.
Caller: This is Singpass support. Receiver: Yes? Caller: Someone tried to log in to your Singpass from overseas. To lock it, I need the verification code that was just sent to your phone.
Caller: Hello, GovTech security operations, Officer Raj. Receiver: Okay. Caller: Your Singpass has been used for crypto accounts. Scan the QR code I send you to verify it is you.

Caller: Hi, this is Mr Lee from DBS Bank card fraud department. Receiver: Yes? Caller: Your card was used at a shop in Johor at three this afternoon for an amount near two thousand dollars. Did you make this payment?

Caller: Good evening, Priya from DBS security team. Receiver: What is this about? Caller: A new credit card was opened in your name this afternoon. I will cancel it, but I need your NRIC and the SMS code.

Caller: This is DBS. We detected an unusual transfer. Receiver: I did not make any transfer. Caller: Then this is a crime. I will connect you to the Singapore Police Force now, please stay on the line.
Caller: This is an automated alert from DBS. A suspicious transaction was found on your account. Press one now to speak to a security officer.

Caller: Hello, Ahmad from OCBC fraud monitoring. Receiver: Yes? Caller: Three transactions are pending on your account, one hundred and fifty dollars each, and they look suspicious. Tell me if they are yours, then I will reverse them.
Caller: Hello sir, OCBC calling, your account got problem. Receiver: What problem? Caller: Somebody login from China just now. I help block, you read me the number on your token.

Caller: Good morning, I am calling from OCBC premier banking. Receiver: Okay. Caller: Your account is listed in an anti-money-laundering review. You need to move your savings to a protected account that we will provide.
Caller: This is UOB card centre. Receiver: Yes? Caller: Your card has been blocked due to suspicious spending. I am Mr Tan. Please confirm the full card number so I can unblock it.
Caller: Hello UOB bank call, Madam. Your credit card have fraud, someone buy iPhone. I Officer Kumar, you give me card number I stop transaction.

Caller: I am Ms Brown from Standard Chartered Bank. Receiver: Yes? Caller: An international wire transfer was initiated in your name. If you did not authorise it, I need your online banking login to cancel it.
Caller: This is HSBC security. Receiver: Okay. Caller: We noticed login attempts from a new device. To protect you, please install the secure app I will guide you to download.
Caller: Hello, Citibank fraud prevention, I am Officer Nurul. Receiver: Yes? Caller: Your card was used for an online purchase of luxury watches. Please hold while I connect you to the police.

Caller: Maybank here, Mr Wong. Receiver: Hi. Caller: A loan of fifty thousand dollars has been approved in your name. If this is not you, you must act now and give me your account details to cancel it.

Caller: Hi, I am calling from your bank's customer security line. Receiver: Which bank? Caller: The bank where you hold your savings account. We want to help you set up extra protection, it will take two minutes.
Caller: Hello, may I speak to Mr Lim? Receiver: Speaking. Caller: Thank you. This is the security department of your bank. We saw a suspicious loan application using your details.
Caller: This is Singtel customer protection. Receiver: Yes? Caller: Your mobile line was used for illegal advertising and will be suspended in one hour. I need your NRIC to clear the report.
Caller: This is Singtel. Your account is overdue and your line will be disconnected today. Press one to speak with an officer.
Caller: Good morning, StarHub technical team. Receiver: Okay. Caller: Hackers entered your home network. I will guide you to a website that removes them, please open it.
Caller: Hello, M1 security department, Raj speaking. Receiver: Yes. Caller: A SIM card registered under your name was found in a fraud case, so the police will call you shortly.
Caller: Singtel network team here. Receiver: I did not call you. Caller: We detected a virus in your router and I can repair it remotely. Please install this support app so I can connect.
Caller: Singtel fraud department, Lee speaking. Receiver: Okay. Caller: An investigation officer from the Cyber Security Agency is monitoring your line. I will transfer you to him.
Caller: Microsoft Technical Support, my name is Kevin Smith. Receiver: Yes? Caller: Your Windows licence has expired and hackers are accessing your files. Please install AnyDesk so I can remove them.
Caller: Thank you for calling Microsoft helpline. Receiver: The screen says my computer is locked. Caller: Do not shut down. I will remove the virus after you download the software I send you.
Caller: Apple Security. Receiver: Yes? Caller: Your Apple ID was used to buy gift cards in another country. I will freeze your account but first read me the verification code.
Caller: This is the Google security team. Receiver: Okay. Caller: Someone is trying to take over your Gmail. Please read out the six-digit code to stop them.
Caller: Hello, Amazon customer service. Receiver: Yes? Caller: An order of an expensive laptop was placed using your account. If you did not authorise it, I will connect you to our fraud department.
Caller: Hi, this is Aisha from the Amazon fraud team. I will now transfer you to the bank so you can block your card.
Caller: This is PayPal security. Receiver: Yes? Caller: A payment of eight hundred dollars to an unknown seller is pending. To cancel it, confirm your login on the link I will text you.

Caller: Hello, I am calling from your internet security provider. Receiver: Which one? Caller: The one installed on your computer. Your licence renewal failed and we found infections. Allow me to connect remotely.
Caller: This is DHL Express customs clearance. Receiver: Yes? Caller: A parcel from overseas under your name contains illegal items. I am Officer Clark. I will transfer you to the police to explain.
Caller: FedEx notification. Receiver: Okay. Caller: Your package has been seized by customs because of an incorrect declaration. Press one to talk to an agent.
Caller: Hello, SingPost security team. Receiver: Yes. Caller: A parcel addressed to you contains drugs and the police will visit. We can help if you confirm your details.
Caller: Ninja Van customer support. Receiver: Okay. Caller: Your parcel cannot be delivered because of an address problem. Pay a small redelivery fee on the link and give me your card details.
Caller: Hello, Shopee seller support. Receiver: Okay? Caller: Your seller account will be banned for fake orders unless you verify your bank account with me now.
Caller: I am from Lazada customer service. Receiver: Yes. Caller: Your order was double charged. For the refund, please follow my steps on your banking app.
Caller: Good afternoon, SP Group billing. Receiver: Yes. Caller: Your electricity account is overdue and we will disconnect supply today unless you verify your payment method now.

Caller: This is Officer Smith from the police. Receiver: Yes? Caller: To prove your money is clean, an officer will meet you downstairs. Please bring your bank cards, cash and any gold, and do not tell the lift attendant or your family.

Caller: Hi, this is Mr Hakim calling about your bank account. Receiver: Okay. Caller: Do not worry, we will never ask for your password. I only need the one-time code that was sent to you, to stop the fraud.

Caller: Hi, Nurul here from the Singapore Police Force. Receiver: What is this about? Caller: I can tell you about it at the station. I have scheduled an appointment for you at the station tomorrow morning. Before that, I need you to confirm your bank details so I can prepare the file.

Caller: Hello, I am with the Monetary Authority of Singapore. Receiver: Yes? Caller: Please go to our verification website that I am sending by SMS, and log in with your internet banking so we can confirm your account is safe.

Caller: This is Officer Rahman from the Cyber Security Agency. Receiver: Okay. Caller: Please download the security application I will message you. It will scan your phone and report to our office directly.

Caller: Hello, this is Singtel technical support, Aisha speaking. Receiver: Yes. Caller: Your router password has been leaked. I will change it for you, so please tell me the current password and your account number.
Caller: Good afternoon, ICA. I am Officer Jones. Receiver: Yes. Caller: To verify that you are the real owner of this passport, I need you to read out the number and your date of birth.

Caller: This is Inspector Chua from the police commercial crime unit. Receiver: Yes? Caller: You must appear at the court on Friday. Bring your passport and your ATM cards, and do not hire a lawyer, it will delay your case.

Caller: Hello, this is Mr Raj from your bank's wealth unit. Receiver: Yes? Caller: I have booked you an urgent appointment with our compliance officer on video call. Please install the meeting app now, because your account will be limited in one hour.
Caller: Hello, this is Inspector Devi ah, from police. Receiver: Yes? Caller: I just need you to confirm your IC number and address for verification, cannot say on phone why, very sensitive.

Caller: Good morning, this is Officer Lim from Bedok Police Division, following up on the report you filed about your stolen bicycle. Receiver: Yes, that is mine. Caller: We recovered a bicycle and the serial number matches. You can collect it at the station with your ID.

Caller: Hello, I am Inspector Priya from the police, calling because you asked for a callback on the traffic report. Receiver: Right. Caller: Your report is registered, and the reference number was sent to your email.

Caller: Good afternoon, this is Sergeant Ahmad. You made a police report last week about a phishing message. Receiver: Yes. Caller: The investigation officer assigned to your case is Officer Wong. She will contact you tomorrow from the station landline.
Caller: Neighbourhood Police Centre here, we are doing a crime prevention visit this weekend. Receiver: Okay. Caller: Officers will carry warrant cards, and you can check the schedule on our website.
Caller: Police hotline, how can I help? Receiver: I received a call asking me to transfer money. Caller: Please do not transfer anything. I will take your details to file a report.

Caller: This is Constable Teo from the Anti-Scam Centre, we received your report. Receiver: Okay. Caller: We have blocked the account you transferred to, and you will get an update by letter. We will never ask you to transfer money.

Caller: Hello, this is Ms Ng from the Monetary Authority of Singapore, returning your email about whether a company is licensed. Receiver: Yes. Caller: That company is not in our register, so I suggest you check the Investor Alert List on our website.
Caller: Good morning, I am calling from MAS to invite you to a financial literacy survey. Receiver: Is it optional? Caller: Completely optional, and you can decline without any consequences.
Caller: Hi, this is MAS media relations calling the journalist who asked for comment. Receiver: Yes, that is me. Caller: Our statement is ready and I am emailing it to you now.

Caller: Hello, I am Mr Kumar, an officer at MOM, returning your call about the work pass renewal. Receiver: Yes, thank you. Caller: Your employer can renew online, and processing takes about two weeks.

Caller: Good afternoon, this is Officer Siti from the MOM inspection unit. Receiver: Yes? Caller: We are scheduling a routine workplace inspection at your company next month. Please tell your HR so the documents are ready.
Caller: Hello, MOM here, you called us this morning ah. Receiver: Yes, about my salary. Caller: Okay, I log your case already, the officer will call back in three working days.

Caller: This is the Ministry of Manpower. Receiver: Hello? Caller: This is an automated reminder that your work permit expires next month. Please renew through the online system and never share your password with anyone.

Caller: Hello, Rahman from ICA customer service, returning your enquiry about passport renewal. Receiver: Yes. Caller: Your application is approved. You may collect your passport at the ICA building with your appointment slip.
Caller: Good morning, this is the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority, confirming your appointment for tomorrow at ten. Receiver: Yes. Caller: Please bring your old passport and the receipt.
Caller: This is an automated message from the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority. Your passport is ready for collection.

Caller: Good afternoon, IRAS here, you booked a callback regarding your property tax. Receiver: Yes. Caller: Your assessment has been revised and the new bill is on your myTax portal. You can read the breakdown there.
Caller: This is a reminder from IRAS that the deadline to file your tax return is approaching. You may file online at any time.

Caller: Hello, this is Ms Devi from CPF Board calling back on your enquiry about housing withdrawal. Receiver: Yes. Caller: You can submit the application online, and I have emailed you the steps. We do not need your password.
Caller: Hi, CPF service centre, just confirming your appointment tomorrow at two. Receiver: Okay. Caller: Please bring your NRIC and any supporting letters.
